classification.difficultyReason: Identify matching end faces and side rectangles, distinguish perpendicular heights from sloping edges, and convert mixed lengths to consistent units before summing areas.

content.prompt:
Find the surface area of these solids.

Set your working out neatly to show that you have considered every face of the solid.

spec.description: Kite prism with dotted horizontal diagonal and external overall vertical-diagonal dimension. Upper sides have single ticks and lower sides double ticks.
spec.mathematics: Diagonals 3 m and 4.4 m, upper side pair 1.7 m, lower side pair 3.9 m; prism length 2.6 m. Retain the supplied rounded measurements.

answer.worked:
Front and back: $2\times\frac{3\times4.4}{2}=13.2\text{ m}^2$.

Top two rectangles: $2(1.7\times2.6)=8.84\text{ m}^2$.

Bottom two rectangles: $2(3.9\times2.6)=20.28\text{ m}^2$.

$$\begin{align*}SA&=13.2+8.84+20.28\\SA&=42.32\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Isosceles-trapezoidal prism with front, top and left face visible. Sloping sides have equal-length ticks; dotted height has a right-angle marker at the base.
spec.mathematics: Parallel edges 33 mm and 63 mm, height 36 mm, each sloping side 39 mm; prism length 82 mm.

answer.worked:
Front and back: $2\times\frac{36}{2}(33+63)=3456\text{ mm}^2$.

Left and right rectangles: $2(39\times82)=6396\text{ mm}^2$.

Top: $33\times82=2706\text{ mm}^2$.

Bottom: $63\times82=5166\text{ mm}^2$.

$$\begin{align*}SA&=3456+6396+2706+5166\\SA&=17\,724\text{ mm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Parallelogram prism with dotted height and base right-angle marker. Opposite horizontal sides carry double parallel arrows; sloping sides carry single parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: Cross-section base 1.3 m, perpendicular height 43 cm, sloping side 47 cm; prism length 86 cm.

answer.worked:
$43\text{ cm}=0.43\text{ m}$, $47\text{ cm}=0.47\text{ m}$ and $86\text{ cm}=0.86\text{ m}$.

Front and back: $2(1.3\times0.43)=1.118\text{ m}^2$.

Top and bottom: $2(1.3\times0.86)=2.236\text{ m}^2$.

Left and right: $2(0.47\times0.86)=0.8084\text{ m}^2$.

$$\begin{align*}SA&=1.118+2.236+0.8084\\SA&=4.1624\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
